title: Eagles general manager Howie Roseman reiterates 'A.J. Brown is an Eagle' after Dontayvion Wicks trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles general manager Howie Roseman reiterates 'A.J. Brown is an Eagle' after Dontayvion Wicks trade
sources.description: The Eagles will face a cap hit of more than $40 million if they trade Brown before June 1 and the cap hit will drop to less than $20 million if they wait after.
